Session cookie fixture page

Loading this page sets a session cookie (no expiry) via document.cookie, scoped to whatever origin serves it. Used by the opt-in browser test (HEADLESS_TEST_BROWSER=1, spec 003-login-persistence) to prove a document.cookie session cookie survives a Session close and a fresh relaunch on the same profile directory, with no real login-protected site involved. This page must be served over http(s), never opened as file://, or document.cookie has no real origin to scope the cookie to.
